end.summary:
Discussed Diwali, harvest festivals, and examples including Pongal and Baisakhi.
Kavya described Diwali activities: fireworks, sweets, and decorating homes.
Harvest and the connection between crops and festivals remained unclear.
Session ended when Kavya asked to stop; teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised festival activities and introduced the idea of harvest festivals, including Pongal and Baisakhi. Kavya shared familiar Diwali examples, while the link between cutting ripe crops, bringing them home, and celebrating remained unclear; it was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, you can talk together about one crop and when people harvest it, then connect it to a related festival.
